create_RotaryEmbedding: create a RotaryEmbedding module with a given dimension and frequency type for language or pixel data
apply_apply_rotary_emb: apply rotary embeddings to a tensor using precomputed frequency tensors with optional scaling
rotate_rotate_queries_or_keys: rotate queries or keys tensor with rotary embeddings using the RotaryEmbedding module
rotate_rotate_queries_and_keys: rotate both queries and keys together with xpos-aware rotary embeddings for length extrapolation
apply_apply_learned_rotations: apply learned rotation parameters to a tensor with optional frequency range filtering
